name: Rullo
title: Pitchmaster
examine: Singed in a different place every week and cheerful about all of them. There is a sign in his own yard with his name on it and it is not a compliment.
lines: Resin burns, pitch burns, my eyebrows burn. It is a whole trade of things burning.
That sign was Halla's idea. I keep meaning to take it down.
Bleed a pine wrong and it dies. Bleed it right and it pays you for forty years.
